source:
@@U02844@@
She’s looking back!
I knew she would!

@@U02846@@
He’s astonished.
A miracle’s happened to him.

@@U02848@@
Not to her.
She’s seen it before.

@@U02850@@
She’s turned with great dignity to face him.

@@U02852@@
She'll be playing tutor to him now.
Men are such fools in these matters.
And he fancies himself the first.

@@U02854@@
Let’s not argue.
Majestically marvelous!

@@U02856@@
The slut!
How vulgar!

@@U02858@@
I sure wouldn't mind trading places with him!

@@U02860@@
She can snare any man she wants.

@@U02862@@
That trinket’s been passed through too many hands;
even the gilding’s worn thin.

@@U02864@@
She’s been at it since she was ten.
translation:
@@U02844@@
她正在回头看！
我就知道她会的！

@@U02846@@
他很惊讶。
奇迹发生在他身上。

@@U02848@@
不是对她。
她以前见过。

@@U02850@@
她非常有尊严地转身面对他。

@@U02852@@
她现在将担任他的导师。
在这些问题上，男人真是愚蠢至极。
他幻想自己是第一。

@@U02854@@
我们不要争论了。
雄伟奇妙！

@@U02856@@
荡妇！
多么粗俗啊！

@@U02858@@
我当然不介意和他交换位置！

@@U02860@@
她可以俘获任何她想要的男人。

@@U02862@@
那件小饰品已经经过了太多人的手；
就连镀金都磨损得稀薄了。

@@U02864@@
她从十岁起就开始这样做了。
